capabilities: Require Ctrl/Cmd+Click to follow links in edit mode
Open links in the current tab, a new tab, or a new window via modifier combinations
Let plain clicks position the cursor to edit link text
Handle internal links, external links, and bare URLs
extras: No configuration is needed; the plugin changes link behavior automatically once enabled. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: This plugin is a fork of the original work by SmallZombie.
motivation: The author wanted to restore traditional link opening behavior so users can freely click and edit link text without accidentally navigating away.
problem: In Obsidian's edit mode, clicking a link navigates away, making it easy to leave a note by accident when trying to edit link text.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a fork of the original work by SmallZombie.

summary: Link-behavior modifier that requires Ctrl/Cmd+Click to open links in edit mode, so plain clicks place the cursor for editing link text.
